decision_rule.text: Re-decision of module M0 (review loop off) under the TRAIN A own null. Let R be the replicate and B0 the first pass, both against the sealed anchor A on the same 1,080 rows with the same paired whole-speaker bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915). Own-null half-widths h_SLU and h_intent are the CI95 half-widths of (R minus B0) for pooled SLU and intent respectively (same rows, same interval level as the clauses). Clause 1 (SLU): the CI95 lower bound of (B0 minus A) exceeds -h_SLU AND the CI95 lower bound of (R minus A) exceeds -h_SLU. Clause 2 (intent): the same with h_intent. NEUTRAL if both clauses hold on both passes; ADMITTED-as-gain if additionally the CI95 lower bound of the pooled SLU delta exceeds zero on both passes; HARMFUL otherwise. Diagnostics reported beside the rule and never used for it: the (R minus B0) point estimates, saves/harms, per-scenario tables, contacts and GPU hours of R, and the anchor-vs-R comparison. This rule replaces the imported DEV1000 margin for this module only; the first-pass status HARMFUL-by-rule stays on record beside the re-decision, as the KC-E1f v1/v2 pair does.

delta_convention: Two signed contrasts. The own null is delta = R minus B0; the re-decision clauses use delta = arm minus anchor, in percentage points, negative is worse.

estimators.not_used: analysis.score_compare_cli as the runner: it hard-codes ci_level 0.90 and DEV population names

metrics.counts: tp = [slu_f1_word_tp, slu_f1_char_tp], fp and fn likewise
metrics.own_null_half_width_pp: computed by this read as h_SLU; no imported value is used

metrics.estimand: per-row mean of joint scenario+action correctness
metrics.own_null_half_width_pp: computed by this read as h_intent; no imported value is used

roster_metadata.carries: sample_id -> scenario, speaker, headset, utterance_id; no text, transcript or gold filler

resampling.seed_advance: paired_contrast advances the seed by the metric index; pooled metrics use the base seed
resampling.sensitivity: paired scenario-stratified row bootstrap, same draws and seed, each scenario resampled to its own size

scorer.runs: once per complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded; this read invokes no scorer

tables_required: own-null table: h_SLU and h_intent with their CI95 and CI90, the (R minus B0) point estimates, saves/harms/ties and the exact two-sided McNemar p
clause table: the CI95 lower bound of (B0 minus A) and of (R minus A) against each half-width, with the clause verdicts
per-scenario table, all 18 scenarios, natural mixture and equal weighting, for both legs
row-identity table: rows whose delivered (scenario, action) pair differs between B0 and R, the diagnostic that says how much of the movement is batch composition
cost table: contacts, contacts per row, repeated speech seconds, FIT endpoints, GPU hours from the serving monitor, mean latency, slot occupancy and duty cycle
